title: How To Create A Landing Page For The Get Matched Form
text:
## How To Create A Landing Page For The Get Matched Form
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000037630
Follow the instructions below to learn how to create a landing page for the Get Matched Form that looks like this:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819754/original/gpL_R27lc9DF34kg3UPxpJid0yXhDR0RJw.png?1682975552 | alt: ]
1. Create a new static page. Refer to this article for more information: How to Create a New Static Page
2. Add a single row using the table option in the Froala Editor, and add a background color and text as desired: Froala Editor .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819761/original/F8djzOMHPHUFp7j2x8e1RiRTMJ2kHPbBsw.png?1682975562 | alt: ]
3. Add a 1 x 2 table to the static page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819768/original/Ibp_ysySXJceT3320dFru8dZVYIZdj4swA.jpeg?1682975575 | alt: ]
4. Add an image on the left side row and enable the "Image Caption" option to add the desired text:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819778/original/w0KL6lifldDvv-Ohq6bmkPzvNtChTZNn1g.jpeg?1682975601 | alt: ]
5. On the right side next to the image, drag and drop the pre-made element Contact Form
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819788/original/0CnIVesknDqksZNQCAv1IPUGopCw_s5K_w.jpeg?1682975612 | alt: ]
6. Change the title and form shortcode to [form=bootstrap_get_match]:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819800/original/Yxqp1RCd2BwGKknnS6buXguD6Yhf7JqHcQ.jpeg?1682975622 | alt: ]
7. Save the changes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819807/original/nQmnAoUSoiQHsixojgicW-r_dCwQsy8IDw.jpeg?1682975633 | alt: ]
